title: The Hunter's Sortie quest named three wolf dens (Charcoal Ring, Twin Stones, Wolf Scrape) but Charcoal Ring was never found despite extensive exploration around the Vale wood; the quest completed anyway after peacefully resolving the other two, leaving it unclear whether the third existed or was optional.
